Name: Sethur, Son of Michael
Summary: Sethur, Son of Michael was one of the twelve spies Moses sent from the tribe of Asher to search out the land of Canaan.
KeyStory: Sethur spent forty days spying out Canaan, then joined the ten who brought back a fearful report that turned Israel back into the wilderness.
RelatedPeople: Michael, Father of Sethur; Moses; Caleb; Joshua
LifeLesson: Seeing the same land as Caleb, he saw only giants — faith is a choice about what you trust.
